title: Hearing Buddy Bolden's band at West End
summary: He remembers Bolden's band from about age seven, hearing it at West End, plus Charlie Charlie playing piano there.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends
